title: Reliability Engineering
description: Parts fail at random, at a steady rate through most of their lives, so the chance one still works falls exponentially. Two in parallel fail only if both do; parts in series fail if any does. Three copies with a vote outlast one only while each is likely to survive: past that point the voter is outvoted by its own broken parts. Spacecraft, aircraft and replicators are designed on this ledger. Unlocks the Reliability Ledger.

puzzle.goal: Three identical parts each work with probability R; a voter takes the majority. Write the chance the voted output is right, R_TMR.
puzzle.name: Triple modular redundancy
puzzle.method: Add the chance all three work, R³, to the three ways exactly two do, 3R²(1 − R).
